assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md says the values come from the config: "`<project-key>` = `TC` (from Jira Configuration)" and "`<vulnerability-issue-type-id>` = `10024` (from Security Configuration / Product Lifecycle)". All three queries start with "project = TC AND issuetype = 10024".

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: Query 1: "... labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged) ORDER BY status ASC, created DESC". Query 2: "... labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New ...". Query 3: "... labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA') ...".

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three separate headed sections divided by horizontal rules: "## 1. Untriaged (4 issues)", "## 2. Triaged but still New (1 issue)" and "## 3. Ready for QA (1 issue)".

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: Every table has the columns Issue | Status | CVE | Summary | Created. Example row: "TC-9001 | New | CVE-2026-40112 | h2 - HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability [rhtpa-2.2] | 2026-06-08". TC-9010 and TC-9020 have rows with the same columns filled in.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md marks TC-9001, TC-9002 and TC-9004 as "**Proceed with full triage.**" For TC-9003 it says "**Warn and ask.** 'This issue is already in `In Progress`. It may be actively worked on.'" discovery-listing.md also shows "Warning: TC-9003 is already **In Progress** and may be actively worked on."

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md shows "TC-9020 | Modified | TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed) | **Included**", "TC-9023 | ... TC-9025 (In Progress) | Excluded: TC-9025 is still open" and "TC-9026 | Modified | (none) | Excluded: no 'Depend' Tasks". The final Ready for QA table lists only TC-9020.
